request.what: Funding for Intersect Technical Steering Committee support activities for 12 months across community engagement, protocol governance, and independent technical review.

claims.claim: Intersect requests $298,250, equivalent to 1,193,000 ADA, to support Technical Steering Committee activities for 12 months.
The proposal allocates 256,000 ADA to WP1, 832,000 ADA to WP2, and 105,000 ADA to WP3, totaling 1,193,000 ADA.
WP2 funds the Parameter Committee, CIP editors, and Hard Fork Working Group to support protocol governance and evolution.

WP3 funds a pilot independent technical review programme launching in 2027, with conflict-of-interest provisions, published recusals, and reviewer selection through an open process against documented criteria.
Technical workshops, the Security Council, and the Bug Bounty Programme are funded separately through the main Intersect budget and are not included in this withdrawal.
All expenditure will be fully accounted for and any unspent funds returned to the Cardano treasury.
Execution of the work packages is contingent on approval of the IntersectMBO budget proposal.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
Independent audits and assurance for this proposal will be provided by Appold, with possible reviews of deliverables, controls, spend validation, and milestone evidence.
Intersect states the requested amount does not, at submission time, breach the 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.

summary: The document requests 1,193,000 ADA for 12 months of TSC support, broken into three work packages for technical coordination, protocol governance, and a 2027 technical-review pilot, with asserted accounting, external assurance, smart-contract treasury management, and NCL compliance.
